  Requirement: Issue #6919 asks for better shard-failure diagnostics, so that a failing test is named at the end of the log. It also says to keep the shard failure gate intact.
  Expected change site: the shard judgment loop in `ci.yml`, `mark-stable.yml` and `test-and-mark-stable.yml`.
